trial_court: II Additional District and Sessions Judge, Mandya, in R.A.no.296/2010 and Civil Judge (Sr.Dn.) and JMFC, Pandavapura, in O.S.NO.180/2009 (Old O.S.no.157/2007).

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Ningegowda, Gangadhara (sons of Late Chunchegowda), aged about 57 years, R/O Nyamanahalli Village, Melukote Hobli, Pandavapura Taluk, Mandya - 571401.
parties.respondent_defendant: Smt. Pavithra, Anusha V W/O Puttegowda, Smt. Nagarathna, W/O Channe Gowda, Siddegowda, Smt. Jayamma (dead by her LRs), Doddegowda, husband of Late Jayamma, Ramegowda, Nagegowda, Suresh, children of Late Jayamma, and Smt. Shantha, W/O Shivanna.

facts_of_case: O.S.no.180/2009 was filed for partition and separate possession of properties.

legal_principles.principle: A child of a marriage which is null and void under Section 11 is entitled to share in joint family properties.
legal_principles.held: It was held that a child of a marriage which is null and void under Section 11 is statutorily entitled to share in the joint family properties.
cited_cases: Revanasiddappa and Anr. v. Mallikarjun and Ors., (2023) 10 SCC 1

legal_principles.principle: Hindu law recognizes the claim of a child born out of a second wife for a share in joint family properties.
legal_principles.held: It was held that Hindu law recognizes the claim of a child born out of a second wife for a share in the joint family properties.
cited_cases: Revanasiddappa and Anr. v. Mallikarjun and Ors., (2023) 10 SCC 1

outcome.final_order: The judgment and decree dated 13.09.2017 passed by II Additional District and Sessions Judge, Mandya, in R.A.no.296/2010 was confirmed.

use_for_drafting: representing clients in joint family matters
